heroHeading: Strategic recruitment for Australia's construction, engineering and insurance sector.
heroSub: ConstructEng Australia places talent on the nation's largest building and civil developments, and across the insurance sector. With 25+ years in technical and executive recruitment, founder Simon Bloom has built an extensive network of engineers, construction professionals and insurance specialists across Australia.
aboutBio: Founded by Simon Bloom in 2009, ConstructEng Australia grew into a recruitment brand with a LinkedIn network of over 15,000 industry professionals. Simon's own background spans executive search inside Transport for NSW's internal talent acquisition function — supporting senior appointments across its once-in-a-generation $76.7B infrastructure program — through to in-house talent leadership for a global insurer. That network and experience now sits behind every ConstructEng search.
